group.name: Please read this before running it

plugin.name: I understand - install it
plugin.description:
THE ROADIE IS NOT A MOD. It is a small tool you run once, yourself, outside the game. It changes nothing about Skyrim, adds no plugin, and needs nothing enabled.
WHAT IT DOES Downloads 22 guitar charts and unpacks them into Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\Bard Hero Songs\guitar, where Bard Hero picks them up on its own - no restart, nothing to press. These are the charts Bard Hero has actually been played against, and each one is pinned by hash, so you get the exact version that was tested or nothing at all.
WHERE THE FILES COME FROM Encore (files.enchor.us), the public chart service the Bridge app uses. It is a plain request for a file - no account, no login, and nothing about you or your game is sent anywhere. Bard Hero itself never connects to the internet; this separate tool is the only part that does, and only when you run it.
WHY A LIST AND NOT A FOLDER OF SONGS A chart is somebody's audio and somebody's charting work. Shipping you the list instead of the songs means the charts reach you from the people who made them, with their names attached.
HOW TO RUN IT Open the "Bard Hero - The Roadie" folder this installs and double-click "Run The Roadie.bat". In Mod Organizer 2, right-click the mod and choose Open in Explorer - the Data folder will not show it, because MO2 virtualises that.
It needs nothing installed. No Python, no extra tools. Both the .bat and the script are plain text, so read them in Notepad first if you would rather not take a mod's word for it.
INSTALLING SOMEWHERE ELSE It defaults to Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\Bard Hero Songs\guitar. To use another folder, run it with: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "songfetch\Get-BardHeroSongs.ps1" -SongsFolder "D:\Wherever\guitar" Add -WhatIfOnly to see what it would do without downloading anything.
WANT MORE THAN 22 SONGS Use Bridge, the Clone Hero chart browser. It browses the whole public database rather than a fixed list, and it writes into the same folder layout. The mod page has the setup - it is three settings and then you are done. The Roadie is a starting repertoire, not a limit.
Thanks for installing, and if you enjoy it, a kind endorsement is always appreciated.
